visualCharacteristics.structure: optional background image + heading + supporting copy

variants.contentPattern: CSS-only. Authored rows and cells render as written. A picture is the full-bleed background. Without a picture, text uses the normal foreground.

visualCharacteristics.structure: category pill + heading + rating + skill level + share bar + image

variants.contentPattern: 1 column x 2 rows. Row 1: hero image. Row 2: paragraph with category link (pill); H1 title; paragraph 'Skill Level: Beginner'. Rating and share bar are injected by decoration (bvId metadata = 990).
